title: Weekend Activities
weather_note: Sunny and dry all weekend. Highs low-to-mid 60s; cold mornings and evenings. Good festival weather — bring layers.

forecast.notable: Dry and comfortable by day; chilly after sunset.
Cold morning; good afternoon for outdoor events.
Dry all day; warmest afternoon of the weekend.

forecast_source: Weather Underground Herndon / NWS Baltimore-Washington outlook, checked October 23, 2026

events.title: Air & Scare at Udvar-Hazy
events.address: 14390 Air and Space Museum Pkwy, Chantilly, VA 20151
events.summary: Celebrate Halloween with aerospace-themed science experiments, crafts, museum exhibits, Star Wars photo opportunities, candy stations and a runway costume show.
events.registration: Free timed tickets required for outdoor activities; indoor activities and exhibits do not require event tickets.

events.title: Halloween on the Farm
events.time: Fri one-hour slots 5–8 PM; Sat 4:30–7:30 PM
events.summary: Visit farm animals, trick-or-treat around the working farm, create seasonal crafts, play games and tour the decorated farmhouse.
events.registration: Advance-registration deadline was Oct 22; verify any remaining slots before traveling. Children need registered adult.

events.title: Halloween House & Trick-or-Treat Trail
events.summary: Walk a nature-themed trick-or-treat trail with costumed characters and live animals, enter the decorated Halloween House, and enjoy cider, popcorn and games.
events.registration: Ages 3+ recommended; registered adult required; timed registration.

events.title: Haunted Mini Golf at Oakmont
events.summary: Play Halloween-themed mini golf while collecting trick-or-treat goodies at every hole. Costumes welcome.
events.registration: Advance-purchase availability may be limited; course closes at 9:30 PM.

events.title: Ghost Town at Burke Lake Park
events.price: $20 advance; $25 at door; under 2 free with adult
events.summary: Ride the miniature train and carousel, play miniature golf, make crafts, and visit costumed trick-or-treat houses around the park.
events.registration: Advance tickets recommended; presale closes two days before each event.

events.title: Trick or Treat Beyond Market Street
events.summary: Trick-or-treat at participating town-center restaurants and stores, collect prizes and giveaways, and enjoy face painting, character appearances, musicians and stilt walkers.
events.registration: Giveaways while supplies last; individual retailers participate.

events.title: Reston Town Center DJ Dance Party
events.time: Music 6–10:30 PM; Sip & Stroll starts 5 PM
events.summary: Dance outdoors to three local DJs, enjoy evening entertainment and grab Sip & Stroll drinks from participating restaurants.
events.registration: Organizer page shows event header ending 9 PM but lists final DJ until 10:30 PM; confirm on site.

events.title: Fall-A-Palooza at Reston Station
events.price: Free admission; food and drinks extra
events.summary: Dance to a DJ and Gonzo's Nose, visit a petting zoo, try the bounce house and games, and enjoy cider donuts, seasonal foods and fall photo opportunities.
events.registration: DJ 4–5 PM; band 5–7 PM.

events.title: Reston Farm Fall Fun Fest
events.summary: Ride a gentle farm train, explore a bouncy inflatable corn maze, feed animals, play on slides and moon bounces and sample fresh cider donuts.
events.registration: Primarily for ages 3–12; date-specific ticket; adults must accompany children.

events.title: Cox Farms Fall Festival
events.summary: Spend the day on giant slides and rope swings, meet animals, explore play areas and take a hayride through the fall farm.
events.registration: Online tickets only; busy days may sell out.

events.title: Fields of Fear
events.summary: Explore scary nighttime haunted attractions at Cox Farms, with dark paths and live scares distinct from the daytime Fall Festival.
events.registration: Online tickets only; not intended for small children.

events.title: BOOtanical Halloween Scavenger Hunt
events.price: $10 hunt sheet plus regular garden admission
events.summary: Follow the Millie Fleur storybook trail, search the Children's Garden and woods for spooky clues, and bring a completed sheet back for a prize.
events.registration: Purchase scavenger sheet at visitor center.

events.title: Spooktacular Halloween Runs
events.summary: Run or cheer on a costumed Monster Mash 5K, Halloween one-mile fun run and Tiny Tot Trot for little runners.
events.registration: Register for the selected distance.

events.title: House of Reptiles
events.summary: Meet live reptiles, try games and a touch table, enjoy s'mores and campfire stories, then explore the woods at dusk.
events.registration: Ages 4+; check Park Authority registration availability.

events.title: An Old-Fashioned Family Murder
events.summary: Enjoy a comic murder mystery in which an inheritance surprise sparks family tension and everybody becomes a suspect.
events.registration: Mild adult themes; recommended ages 10+; ticketed seating.

events.title: Remember the Ladies: An America 250 Concert
events.address: 11216 Waples Mill Rd Suite 103, Fairfax, VA 22030
events.summary: An all-female cast tells American women's stories through song and performance while reflecting on the nation's 250th year.
events.registration: Purchase tickets for chosen performance.

events.title: Borisevich Duo Chamber Concert
events.summary: Hear violinist Nikita Borisevich and pianist Margarita Loukachkina with their young pianist son in a chamber-music recital.
events.registration: All ages; ticketed performance.

events.title: Halloween at The Boo-ro
events.summary: Decorate mini pumpkins, trick-or-treat, enjoy a magician and DJ, get glitter tattoos and pose for photos with costumed pets.
events.registration: RSVP available via organizer.

events.title: Toad the Wet Sprocket Acoustic Tour
events.address: 7750 Capital One Tower Rd, Tysons, VA 22102
events.summary: Hear acoustic arrangements from the alternative-rock band known for Walk on the Ocean and All I Want.
events.registration: Check ticket availability and separate parking.

events.title: Wyclef Jean with the Fairfax Symphony
events.address: 7750 Capital One Tower Rd, Tysons, VA 22102
events.summary: Hear the artist and Fugees cofounder reimagine hip-hop, reggae and Caribbean-influenced hits alongside a full symphony orchestra.
events.registration: One-night-only concert; parking separate.

events.title: Virginia Hauntings: Legends & Lore
events.address: 10017 Colvin Run Rd, Great Falls, VA 22066
events.summary: Hear local ghost stories and legends on a lantern-lit guided tour through historic buildings and the 19th-century gristmill.
events.registration: Ages 12+; check tickets and exact dates with the park.

events.title: Halloween Family Skate & Dance Night
events.summary: Bring skates and a Halloween costume for family-friendly skating, music and a costume-themed dance night.
events.registration: Bring your own skates; check organizer requirements.

events.title: 76th Annandale Parade
events.summary: Watch bands, dancers, antique vehicles, fire trucks and costumed groups process down Columbia Pike. Children may wear Halloween costumes.
events.registration: Road closures and route changes; see the Chamber's official route map.

events.title: Falls Church Halloween Carnival
events.summary: Play carnival games, win small treats and toys, jump in inflatables and take part in a children's costume contest.
events.registration: For children 11 and under with adults; attend one time slot; no registration required.

events.title: Monster Mash at Village at Leesburg
events.address: 1602 Village Market Blvd SE, Leesburg, VA 20175
events.summary: Watch professional pumpkin carving, trick-or-treat, decorate cookies, get face painting, and enter family and pet costume contests.
events.registration: Costume contest 3:30–4:30 PM; Loudoun Sheriff's Child Safety Day runs alongside.

events.title: 30th Del Ray Halloween Parade
events.venue: Mount Vernon Avenue & E Bellefonte Avenue
events.summary: Join or watch a neighborhood Halloween parade of families, costumed dogs and decorated strollers, ending with music and awards.
events.registration: Pet costume entrants register by 1:30 PM; decorated stroller and group contests.

events.title: Mount Vernon Fall Harvest Family Days
events.address: 3200 Mount Vernon Memorial Hwy, Mount Vernon, VA 22121
events.summary: Watch horse-powered wheat treading, historic crafts, soap-making and cooking demonstrations; meet farm animals and interpreters, try old-time lawn games and scavenger hunts.
events.registration: Free first-come tickets for certain barn demonstrations; estate admission required.

events.title: Workhouse HAUNT: Dark Encounters
events.time: Evening; ticketed arrival slots around 7–10 PM
events.summary: Follow an immersive, story-driven haunted trail into the woods, solving a dark mystery through unsettling scenes, characters and surprises.
events.registration: Recommended ages 13+; buy a timed-entry ticket; Friday and weekend dates listed by organizer.

events.title: Great Country Farms Pumpkin Harvest
events.time: 9 AM–5 PM; last pumpkin wagon 4 PM
events.price: Advance Fri $12 child/$14 adult; weekend $14 child/$16 adult + fee; pumpkins extra
events.summary: Pick pumpkins, ride a wagon, explore a corn maze and giant play area; weekend extras include pig races, pumpkin cannons, a pumpkin-eating dinosaur and cider-pressing demos.
events.registration: Pumpkin picking ends at 4 PM; advance tickets available.

events.title: Adult Corn Maze Night at Henway
events.venue: Great Country Farms / Henway Hard Cider
events.summary: Navigate a nighttime corn maze with a flashlight, then relax at a bonfire with live music and an included cider or wine pour.
events.registration: Ages 21+; bring your own flashlight; limited tickets often sell out.

events.title: Maryland Renaissance Festival: Final Weekend
events.price: Adult $31 + tax/fees; ages 7–15 $17 + fees; 6 and under free ticket
events.summary: Explore a full Renaissance village with stage performers, craft demonstrations, elaborate costumes, jousting and seasonal food.
events.registration: Last weekend of season; online-only date-specific tickets including free child tickets.

events.title: International Gold Cup Steeplechase
events.address: 5089 Old Tavern Rd, The Plains, VA 20198
events.price: Admission $81; vehicle parking pass extra ($100 listed)
events.summary: Watch seven races, including the International Gold Cup, plus hat and tailgate contests in Virginia horse country.
events.registration: Ticket and parking sold separately; significant event-day expense and traffic.

events.title: Doukénie Winery October Harvest Festival
events.time: Saturday; event hours verify with venue
events.price: General-entry price not confirmed; barrel tasting ticketed
events.summary: Listen to live music, browse handmade gifts and local art, enjoy food trucks and watch playful Lucy-inspired grape stomping.
events.registration: Separate ticket for barrel tasting; confirm entry and event hours.

events.title: Workhouse Historic Flashlight Tours
events.time: Evening during HAUNT; last departure no later than 9:45 PM
events.summary: Walk historic cellblocks and former prison grounds by flashlight on a guided history tour separate from the scary HAUNT trail.
events.registration: Buy on site; no advance reservation; tour timing depends on HAUNT operations.

events.title: Carnival of Curiosities Art Exhibition
events.time: Gallery hours vary; confirm before visit
events.summary: See visual artworks inspired by strange carnival attractions, circus curiosities, magic and theatrical oddities.
events.registration: Exhibition runs throughout October; gallery opening hours vary.

events.title: Bat Boy: The Musical
events.summary: See a campy horror-comedy musical about a half-boy, half-bat outsider trying to fit into a small town.
events.registration: Ticketed matinee; content more suited to teens and adults.

events.title: Betrayal by Harold Pinter
events.time: Performance times vary; see ticket calendar
events.summary: Watch a tense story about a marriage and an affair unfold in reverse chronological order, revealing the memories and secrets behind a betrayal.
events.registration: Closing weekend Oct 25; check times and availability.
